name: 08558 · Skillman, NJ
findings: ZIP 08558 (Skillman) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08558 (Skillman) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08558 (Skillman) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
